_comment: Constraints #8 — the unreadable list, as data rather than prose.
Every tracked file a text scan cannot honestly read appears here with the
alternative method that cleared it, or the literal words 'not cleared'.
tests/unreadableList.test.mjs fails CI on any undeclared member, on any
entry lacking a method, and on any proof reference that does not resolve.
This list was empty for about an hour because I generated it with a broken
command — a heredoc took stdin, so the scanner read zero paths and reported
a clean tree. The gate below reads the tree itself for that reason: a list
maintained by hand is only as good as the last hand that maintained it.
